['H\u00fcttenwerke Krupp Mannesmann GmbH.company_description: Hüttenwerke Krupp Mannesmann GmbH, also known as HKM, is a German steel company based in Duisburg. It is owned by ThyssenKrupp and operates in the heavy industry sector, specifically in steel production. The company is known for its production of steel products and operates the Rhine ports of Schwelgern and Walsum-Süd. HKM has a significant presence in the transportation and communication sector, particularly in railways and shipping.

['Rolls-Royce Deutschland Ltd & Co KG '].company_description: Rolls-Royce Deutschland Ltd & Co KG is involved in the production of turbofan engines, specifically the BR700-710A1-10, BR700-710A2-20, and BR700-710C4-11 models. The company has been the subject of a new airworthiness directive (AD) issued by the FAA due to reports of cracks on certain low-pressure compressor (LPC) rotor (fan) disks.
